entries.title: Job 35:2
segments: Thinkest thou this to be [thy] right, [Or] sayest thou, My righteousness is more than God's,

entries.title: Job 35:3
segments: That thou sayest, What advantage will it be unto thee? [And], What profit shall I have, more than if I had sinned?

entries.title: Job 35:4
segments: I will answer thee, And thy companions with thee.

entries.title: Job 35:5
segments: Look unto the heavens, and see; And behold the skies, which are higher than thou.

entries.title: Job 35:6
segments: If thou hast sinned, what effectest thou against him? And if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

entries.title: Job 35:7
segments: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? Or what receiveth he of thy hand?

entries.title: Job 35:8
segments: Thy wickedness [may hurt] a man as thou art; And thy righteousness [may profit] a son of man.

entries.title: Job 35:9
segments: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out; They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

entries.title: Job 35:10
segments: But none saith, Where is God my Maker, Who giveth songs in the night,

entries.title: Job 35:11
segments: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, And maketh us wiser than the birds of the heavens?

entries.title: Job 35:12
segments: There they cry, but none giveth answer, Because of the pride of evil men.

entries.title: Job 35:13
segments: Surely God will not hear an empty [cry], Neither will the Almighty regard it.

entries.title: Job 35:14
segments: How much less when thou sayest thou beholdest him not, The cause is before him, and thou waitest for him!

entries.title: Job 35:15
segments: But now, because he hath not visited in his anger, Neither doth he greatly regard arrogance;

entries.title: Job 35:16
segments: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vanity; He multiplieth words without knowledge.
